opus.problem: The cited verse (Ezekiel 16:49) says only 'your sister Sodom'. The 'younger sister' detail comes from Ezekiel 16:46, so this part of the clue is not true to its reference.

The cited verse (Genesis 14:12) says only that they carried off Lot and his possessions. The four kings come from 14:9, and the seizing of the city's goods comes from 14:11, so the clue goes beyond its reference.
